columns.trigger: The implementation and delivery phase specified in the onboarding plan has been co-executed. The Customer and HERE are ready to meet and decide on the readiness for Launch
objectives: Determine with customer and HERE if solution is ready to adopt, launch operate and support

The tollgate review has three possible outcomes:
Not Launch: Continue with "Failure Analysis Postmortem" 
Postpone Launch: Continue with "Remove Launch Blockers" Launch: Continue with "Adopt"
key_activities: Create tollgate review record with agreed next steps, owners and due dates
If launch is no-go (failure), create postmortem review record with reason for failure findings and action plan to address these and prevent reoccurrence.

If postponed, the Onboarding team conducts an analysis of the findings, works with all stakeholders including the Customer, puts in place a mitigation plan and executes it to remove those obstacles - back to tollgate progess.
Customer provides feedback, i.e. onboarding CSAT survey is conducted
metrics: Onboarding ratio - # Onboarded Customers/# Customers in commercial operation
